purpose: Correct the prior scope-based pilot by keeping all 1000 conversations eligible for every query
no_scope_rule: Reconstruct each frozen 1000-ID pool by concatenating its archived original+distractor ID lists, then treat all 1000 identically. Do not use that partition, sample_id, family, knowledge-space ID, or official references to filter or rank.
person_rule: Question names are fixed below, not inferred from gold. A source qualifies when any name exactly matches a structured turn speaker OR appears as a case-insensitive whole word in its original text. No entity disambiguation or stable person_id is claimed.
query_rule: Compare original question with the BM25 keyword input already published in smm-query-input-001/authored-inputs.tsv; do not edit queries for this experiment.
time_rule: Only for an explicit English month+year date: parse exact day, or days 1-10 for 'beginning/early'. Multiply BM25 score by 1.25 when source received_at UTC date is in interval. Undated sources remain unchanged. Do not filter, and leave all other questions unchanged.
primary_metrics: Top5 at least one official reference and Top5 all official references, with Top10 and source retention secondary
limitations: These 12 known cases were chosen for diagnostic contrast, not random/blind. Names are supplied from questions; this does not validate person extraction, coreference, or stable entity IDs. Official references are an imperfect proxy for answer sufficiency.
